verdict.rationale: Grok Bot's docs show its Bots analyzing user data inside the product: answering metrics questions from a data warehouse, reviewing dashboards and traces to find the highest-confidence hotspot, running a daily customer-risk skill against an account list, and handling CSV, JSON and notebook files. These are use-case examples rather than a documented insights feature, and suggestions are only implied. Missing for 10: a documented, explicit insights/suggestions capability (beyond use-case prompts), evidence of proactive recommendations from user data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of data-insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Team Bots suit one shared job, such as answering metrics questions from your data warehouse
Review dashboards, traces, and flamegraphs; identify the highest-confidence hotspot
Every weekday at 8:00 AM, run the Daily customer-risk skill against the current account list.
CSV, JSON, YAML, and source-code files ... Jupyter notebooks
